summary: Preserve stream 'close' as resource closure, distinct from readable end and writable finish.

target.notes: Register through EventEmitter semantics; close indicates stream and underlying resource closure and, when emitted, no further stream events should follow. emitClose:false can suppress it.

caveats: Do not synthesize close merely because end/finish occurred; some resources close on different timing.
Host-specific stream subclasses may have additional close causes.

tests.name: destroy normally closes
tests.input: const {PassThrough}=require('node:stream'); const s=new PassThrough(); s.on('close',()=>console.log('close')); s.destroy();

tests.name: emitClose false suppresses
tests.input: const {Writable}=require('node:stream'); const w=new Writable({emitClose:false,write(c,e,cb){cb()}}); let n=0; w.on('close',()=>n++); w.destroy(); setImmediate(()=>console.log(n));
